tips.label: spend：人花時間或金錢
tips.text: 人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋on＋名詞，或人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋V-ing。過去式為 spent。

tips.label: cost：事物花費金錢
tips.text: 事物＋cost＋人＋金錢；It costs＋人＋金錢＋to V。cost 的過去式、過去分詞皆為 cost。

tips.label: take：做事花費時間
tips.text: 事情＋take＋人＋時間；It takes＋人＋時間＋to V。take 的過去式為 took。

tips.label: 過去完成式
tips.text: 主詞＋had＋過去分詞，表示在過去某個時點之前的動作、持續狀態或經驗。

notes.title: spend：主詞是人
notes.rule:
人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋on＋名詞
人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋V-ing
notes.description: spend 可以表示花時間或花錢。動作放在 spend 後面時用 V-ing。三態為 spend–spent–spent；現在式第三人稱單數用 spends。
examples: Shelly spends all of her money on luxuries.（Shelly 把所有錢都花在奢侈品上。）
Shelly spends all of her money buying luxuries.（Shelly 把所有錢都拿來買奢侈品。）
Charlie spent the whole afternoon shopping in the supermarket.（Charlie 花了整個下午在超市購物。）

notes.title: cost：主詞是事物或虛主詞 it
notes.rule:
事物＋cost（＋人）＋金錢
It＋cost（＋人）＋金錢＋to V
notes.description: 本課的 cost 用來表示花費金錢。主詞是買的東西，或用 it 搭配 to V。三態為 cost–cost–cost；現在式第三人稱單數用 costs。人稱代名詞放在 cost 後要用受格，如 me、him、us。
examples: The dress cost Ms. Wu 500 dollars.（這件洋裝花了伍小姐 500 元。）
It cost Ms. Wu 500 dollars to buy the dress.（買這件洋裝花了伍小姐 500 元。）
It cost all Scott’s savings to buy the house.（買這間房子花了 Scott 所有的積蓄。）

notes.title: take：事情花費時間
notes.rule:
事情＋take（＋人）＋時間
It＋take（＋人）＋時間＋to V
notes.description: 本課用 take 表示做某件事需要多少時間。以動作當主詞時可用 V-ing；以 it 當主詞時，後面的動作用 to V。三態為 take–took–taken；現在式第三人稱單數用 takes。
examples: Finishing his homework took Harry an hour.（完成作業花了 Harry 一小時。）
It took Harry an hour to finish his homework.（Harry 花了一小時完成作業。）
It took me two days to write this report.（寫這份報告花了我兩天。）

notes.title: 過去完成式：過去之前
notes.description: 先找一個過去的時間點，再看在那之前發生了什麼。had 不隨人稱改變。不可在 had 後接原形或一般過去式，例如 had seen，不是 had saw。
examples: When I arrived, the movie had already started.（我抵達時，電影已經開始了。）
The staff had cleaned the room before we arrived.（我們抵達前，工作人員已經清理好房間。）

notes.title: 過去完成式的三種情境
notes.rule: 已完成的動作／持續到過去某時的狀態／過去之前的經驗
notes.description: ① 完成：某動作在過去某時點前已完成。② 持續：某狀態在過去某時點前已持續一段時間，常搭配 for。③ 經驗：在過去某時點前有過或沒有過某經驗，可搭配 never。before、when 等是時間線索，不是看到就一定用過去完成式；重點是先後關係。
examples: We had paid the fee before the tour began.（導覽開始前，我們已經付了費用。）
My parents had lived here for ten years when I was born.（我出生時，父母已經在這裡住了十年。）
Before that visit, I had never seen such a fish.（那次參觀之前，我從未見過那樣的魚。）

quiz.question: Amy ___ two hundred dollars on a souvenir yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞 Amy 是人，搭配 on a souvenir；yesterday 表示過去，spend 要用 spent。

quiz.question: We spent an hour ___ with the animals.
quiz.hint: spend＋時間＋V-ing 表示花時間做某事，所以用 interacting。

quiz.question: It took us ten minutes ___ through the tunnel.
quiz.hint: It took＋人＋時間後接 to V，所以用 to walk。

quiz.question: The souvenir ___ me fifty dollars yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞是物品，後接人與金額，用 cost；cost 的過去式也是 cost。

quiz.question: By the time we arrived, the staff ___ already cleaned the room.
quiz.hint: 清理發生在過去的抵達之前，用 had＋過去分詞。

quiz.question: My brother spends thirty minutes ___ biology every day.
quiz.hint: spends＋時間後接 V-ing，表示花時間讀生物。

quiz.question: It ___ me an hour to reach the university yesterday.
quiz.hint: It takes＋人＋時間＋to V；yesterday 要用過去式 took。

quiz.question: The tickets ___ us six hundred dollars in total yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞是票券，花費的是金錢，用 cost；yesterday 表示過去，cost 的過去式不變。

quiz.question: Before the trip began, we had ___ the fee.
quiz.hint: 過去完成式為 had＋過去分詞；pay 的過去分詞是 paid。

quiz.question: Yesterday, Ben ___ the whole afternoon watching over his sister.
quiz.hint: 人＋spent＋時間＋V-ing；主詞 Ben 是人，且 yesterday 表示過去。

quiz.question: It cost me three hundred dollars ___ the bag.
quiz.hint: It cost＋人＋金錢後接 to V，表示做某事花費金錢。

quiz.question: The children had ___ asleep before the bus arrived.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞；fall 的三態是 fall、fell、fallen。

quiz.question: Checking the schedule ___ me five minutes yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞是 Checking the schedule 這件事，花費的是時間，所以用 took。

quiz.question: How much money did you ___ on souvenirs yesterday?
quiz.hint: 疑問句已有助動詞 did，spend 必須用原形。

quiz.question: Our guide had ___ at the university before he moved here.
quiz.hint: had 後面要接過去分詞，teach 的過去分詞是 taught。

quiz.question: It takes my little brother ten minutes ___ asleep.
quiz.hint: It takes＋人＋時間後接 to V，所以用 to fall。

quiz.question: This unique cup ___ fifty dollars at the shop today.
quiz.hint: 主詞 This unique cup 是單數，目前價格用現在式 costs。

quiz.question: We had ___ the schedule before the teacher asked about it.
quiz.hint: 先看到、後被問，使用 had＋過去分詞；see 的過去分詞是 seen。

quiz.hint: spend＋金錢＋V-ing 表示花錢做某事，所以用 buying。

quiz.question: It took Harry an hour ___ his biology homework.
quiz.hint: It took＋人＋時間後接 to V，因此選 to finish。

quiz.question: Grandpa had ___ before I was born.
quiz.hint: 退休發生在出生之前；had 後用過去分詞 retired。

quiz.hint: 冒險旅程是事物，花費金錢用 cost；last summer 表示過去，cost 過去式不變。

quiz.hint: 助動詞 does 後接原形 take，詢問所需時間。

quiz.question: By the time Dad came home, I had ___ my homework.
quiz.hint: 回家前就完成，用過去完成式 had finished。

quiz.question: We spent an unforgettable evening ___ with the staff.
quiz.hint: spend＋一段時間後接 V-ing，所以用 talking。

quiz.question: It ___ two hundred dollars to join the trip last week.
quiz.hint: last week 表示過去；It cost＋金錢＋to V，cost 的過去式仍是 cost。

quiz.question: The rain had ___ for hours before it stopped.
quiz.hint: 表示雨在過去停止之前已持續數小時，用 had＋過去分詞 lasted。

quiz.question: The staff spend two hours ___ the rooms every morning.
quiz.hint: spend＋時間後的動作使用 V-ing，因此選 cleaning。

quiz.question: It takes me twenty minutes ___ the animal show.
quiz.hint: It takes＋人＋時間後面的動作用 to V。

quiz.question: I had never ___ such a unique fish before that visit.
quiz.hint: before that visit 指過去某次參觀之前的經驗，用 had never seen。

quiz.question: My sister ___ most of her money on books every month.
quiz.hint: every month 表示現在習慣，My sister 為第三人稱單數，用 spends。

quiz.question: The two souvenirs ___ eighty dollars in total yesterday.
quiz.hint: 表示花費金錢的 cost，其過去式是 cost，不是 costed。

quiz.question: The visitors had already ___ when the rain began.
quiz.hint: 遊客離開早於下雨，had 後接 leave 的過去分詞 left。

quiz.question: Did it ___ you long to find the university?
quiz.hint: 句首已有 Did，後面的動詞用原形 take。

quiz.question: Tom spent the afternoon ___ memories with his grandfather.
quiz.hint: spent＋時間＋V-ing，表示花下午的時間分享回憶。

quiz.question: By the time the tour started, everyone ___ paid the fee.
quiz.hint: 付款早於過去的導覽開始，用 had paid。

quiz.question: It cost us a thousand dollars ___ the broken door.
quiz.hint: It cost＋人＋金錢＋to V，因此選 to fix。

quiz.question: How much time do you ___ checking your schedule each week?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 do 後用原形 spend，接時間與 checking。

quiz.question: We hurried up because the show had already ___.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞；begin 的三態是 begin、began、begun。

quiz.question: Walking through the long tunnel ___ us half an hour yesterday.
quiz.hint: 走過隧道這件事花費時間，使用 take；yesterday 要用 took。

quiz.question: Before we arrived, the shop had ___ all its souvenirs.
quiz.hint: 售完早於抵達，使用 had＋sell 的過去分詞 sold。

quiz.question: It usually ___ my father five minutes to fall asleep.
quiz.hint: usually 表示現在習慣；主詞 It 為單數，用 takes。

quiz.question: My parents had ___ here for ten years when I was born.
quiz.hint: 到我出生這個過去時點之前已住十年，用 had lived。

quiz.question: I spent fifty dollars ___ this notebook yesterday.
quiz.hint: spent＋金錢後可接 V-ing，表示花錢買筆記本。

quiz.question: The guide had ___ us the schedule before the tour began.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞，give 的過去分詞是 given。

quiz.question: It did not ___ much money to buy the souvenir.
quiz.hint: did not 後面使用原形 cost。

quiz.question: By the time we got to the park, the staff had ___ the gate.
quiz.hint: 開門早於抵達公園，had 後接過去分詞 opened。

quiz.question: It took my sister two hours ___ the report.
quiz.hint: It took＋人＋時間後接 to V，因此選 to write。

quiz.question: Before that adventure, I had never ___ away from home.
quiz.hint: 表示那次冒險之前的經驗，用 had never been；be 的過去分詞是 been。

quiz.question: Three generations of our family had ___ in this town before we moved.
quiz.hint: had 後需要過去分詞，grow 的過去分詞為 grown，所以選 grown up。
